==Location and Uses==
==={{BotW|-}}===
Metal Chests are a metallic type of [[Treasure Chest]] with gold banding and [[Hylian Crest]]s adorning their sides. Due to their metallic composition, they can be manipulated with [[Magnesis]]. They can also be affected by [[Stasis]]. They can conduct [[Electricity]] and may attract [[Lightning]]. When viewed with the [[Camera]] [[Rune]], they can be registered in the [[Hyrule Compendium]]. Once registered in the Compendium, they can be [[Sheikah Sensor +]] targets, though they will not be distinguished from other types of Treasure Chest by the Compendium and Sheikah Sensor +.

Metal Chests do not contain any different [[Item]]s from other Treasure Chests. In addition to being found on the ground, they can also be found underwater or embedded in the ground. In both cases Magnesis is required to retrieve them. They can also randomly appear as [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] Rune rewards.

[[Hidden Chest]]s are a type of Metal Chest added in the [[Breath of the Wild Expansion Pass]] and its [[Downloadable Content]] packs. They contain exclusive [[Armor]] or Items like the [[Ancient Saddle]] or [[Travel Medallion]]. Most are buried underground and must be retrieved with Magnesis to open.

==={{TotK|-}}===
Iron Treasure Chests are a metallic type of [[Treasure Chest]] decorated with gold-colored banding and simplified [[Hylian Crest]]s. They do not contain any different [[Item]]s from other Treasure Chests, but they can be manipulated and moved about with [[Ultrahand]]. Though they can be merged together with other [[Object]]s, they cannot be [[Fuse]]d. Due to their metallic composition, they can conduct [[Electricity]] and may attract [[Lightning]]. When viewed with the [[Camera]], they can be registered in the [[Hyrule Compendium]] and set as [[Sensor]] targets. However, the Hyrule Compendium and Sensor will not distinguish them apart from other types of Treasure Chest.

Iron Treasure Chests are typically found throughout the [[Surface]]. They can be located underwater or embedded in the ground. In both cases, [[Ultrahand]] is required to retrieve them. Iron Treasure Chests can appear as random drops from the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Ancient Power]].
